t: This Erbauer SDS Plus shank masonry drill bit, measuring 16mm in diameter and 460mm in length, is engineered for drilling clean and accurate holes in tough materials. Featuring a hardened steel alloy shank and a ground tungsten carbide 2-cutter cross tip, it is ideal for electricians working on concrete walls or general builders needing to drill into brickwork, mortar, and stone. The single-flute design efficiently removes debris, ensuring consistent performance. Its universal compatibility means it fits most SDS Plus rotary hammers, including popular brands like Erbauer, Bosch, Titan, and Fein, making it a versatile addition to any toolkit.
b: Ground 2-Cutter Tip Delivers Clean, Precise Holes
Single-Flute Design for Efficient Debris Removal
Fits Erbauer, Bosch, Titan & Fein SDS Plus Tools
